meaning:
1) to wake, watch, awake, be alert
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to keep watch of, be wakeful over
1a2) to be wakeful, wake (as mourner or sufferer)

renderings.kjv: that like as I have watched over

elsewhere.note: Watch and keep them, until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel, at Jerusalem…
Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
